newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen down on finance concerns.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen down on finance concerns.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to decline slightly on Monday as investors are seen selling finance stocks which are likely to post poor first quarter earning results, brokers said.
"The SET index is likely to fall slightly. Investors are ready to sell any finance stocks which post poor earnings during the first quarter," said Bumnan Liumsuwan of Asia Credit.
Most finance companies are expected to release their first quarter figures this week.
The composite SET index closed 1.53 points lower at 700.23 on 3.4 billion baht turnover on Friday.
Finance firms and banks, hit by slowing economic growth and increased provisioning requirements, are widely expected to report poor first quarter earnings, brokers said.
